text:
nina: scan-bot reported SAST marked as SKIPPED for repo monorepo/libs and blocked the premerge gate. tagging @omar @felix. :confused:
omar: link + log?
nina: https://ci.redwood/runs/6701; snippet:
```
SAST: status=SKIPPED reason=artifact_fetch_failed error=403 service="scanner"
{"serviceAccount":"scanner-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com","error":"accessDenied"}
```

felix: I rolled back the oauth.exchange role on that SA during the last RBAC tidy (PR 2478) — thought it wasn't used anymore. apparently the scanner exchanges short-lived tokens to read internal package artifacts.
audit-bot: to gather provenance for product-security, run this KMS audit query for the key used to seal ephemeral tokens: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/pki/cryptoKeys/token-sign-key
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\" AND protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"pki\" AND timestamp>\"2026-08-10T00:00:00Z\"" --limit 200
```

omar: important: product-security wants linkage: which job_id tried to pull artifacts vs which key unwrap/sign happened. need logs that include job_id metadata.
nina: quick unblock plan: temporarily restore oauth.exchange for scanner-runner, re-run SAST, then capture KMS sign logs and attach to INFSEC-2337.
felix: alternative long-term: change scanner to fetch artifacts via an infra proxy that mints per-run URLs (no SA exchange) and record the job_id in the URL token. That avoids giving SA broad oauth rights. I'll draft RFC.
audit-bot: suggested short-term gcloud to correlate logs with job_id: add filter "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"scanner-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND jsonPayload.job_id: \"${CI_JOB_ID}\""
nina: filed INFSEC-2337: "premerge SAST skipped due to artifact access RBAC change". assigning fix to @felix and evidence to @omar. adding checklist: (1) attach KMS AsymmetricSign logs (2) reinstate ephemeral url proxy RFC (3) presubmit rule: SKIPPED => FAIL (4) audit RBAC changeplaybook to include scanner smoke test.
omar: re-run started: https://ci.redwood/runs/6702
scan-bot: SAST 6702: 1 MED, 4 LOW — gate cleared. report: https://scans.redwood/6702.json
felix: opened rfc/ephemeral-artifact-proxy.md and linked INFSEC-2337. will include expected audit fields and KMS signing flow so product-security can validate.
audit-bot: evidence attached to INFSEC-2337: CI logs + gcloud query + scan artifact. setting retention note for 90 days on KMS logs.
nina: follow-ups captured. closing thread but leaving ticket open until RFC merged and presubmit updated. :white_check_mark:
